title: Decision in Gülşen Tarhan case
paragraphs: The verdict in the case of Ege Lencek correspondent Gülşen Tarhan on charges of defamation has been announced. The result is 10 months in prison.

According to the indictment, Gülşen Tarhan insulted a public official with reports of a leak in the garbage storage area published on July 12, 2025. The sentence was carried out by the Turkish Penal Code 125 (designation).
The verdict was announced at the hearing dated 21 May 2026 by Muğla 1st Criminal Court. The sentence has not yet been issued.
In the Gülşen Tarhan case, Attorney Derya Sönmez said the defence witnesses were not allowed to be heard.
Gülşen Tarhan works as a journalist at the Ege Lencek broadcaster. Journalists' organisations said the case could have a deterrent effect on freedom of the press.
There will be an appeal against the decision, and Gülsen Tarhan is free.
